findings.title: Key scanner loses overlapping text-key matches in malformed progress

steps: Create old and current ClaudeProvider.round with fake EventEmitter RPC; start StructuredOutput block 0.
Push the raw progress string below, either whole or at every split.
Inspect emitted events before sending the final result. Finish both with {text:"final fallback",action:null}.

findings.cause: After matching the first closing quote of "text", key=6 waits for a colon. When the next t arrives it resets to zero, forgetting that the previous closing quote also starts another overlapping "text" token. The old regex retries from that previous quote and matches the second token.
findings.impact: Changes emitted progress and can change final displayed text when final output is incompatible with the earlier streamed prefix. Only malformed key prefixes reproduced; ordinary schema-conforming text-first JSON was unaffected in these checks. No authority bypass found.
findings.recommendation: Preserve the overlapping quote-prefix state when a completed key fails its colon match, and add whole-chunk, character-wise and every-split old-round differential fixtures. Retain bounded state and no accumulated raw JSON.
findings.proof: 42 failing split variants across two overlapping-key forms; all other added cases matched. Existing 14 tests pass and miss this case.

claude: Full original partialText helper, safe CLI arguments, native-tool rejection, final validation/fallback and action separator logic are unchanged against saved before source. No accumulated raw JSON remains in round; only decoded pending text, four unicode digits, scalar decoder state and emitted output remain.

Checked all two-way splits plus UTF-16 character chunks of valid escape/literal fixtures, raw escaped trailing backslashes, literal backslash-u suffixes with 0/1/3/4 hex digits, incomplete and invalid escapes, raw controls, escaped surrogate halves and pairs, raw astral text and lone surrogates. Supplemented with 400 deterministic three-block rounds using seed 90123.

Checked shorter/equal/longer/conflicting/empty block prefixes, including surrogate overlap and trailing backslash overlap. Newly decoded segments only emit after the previous emitted prefix agrees. Final result validity and listener/abort cleanup covered by focused production tests.

Final validation remains the original text-string plus own action-property check, not independent full JSON Schema validation. Tool authority is not expanded by this diff. No real provider or CLI invoked by review probes.
